verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way for a lead to allowlist or restrict which external tools, MCP servers, or integrations the agents may use. The closest items are a developer note that Conductor's own GitHub integration can now use fine-grained repository access, and per-organization choice of API key versus subscription for agent connections. Both are adjacent controls, not agent tool-access governance, and the docs instead say cloud agents run steps without asking for confirmation.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control which external tools and integrations the agent is allowed to access
